text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her potential as a stayer blossomed in 
full. Hishi Miracle pulled off a 
miraculous victory on this grand stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"I want you to become an Umamusume who can 
set her own goals." Carrying that wish 
from her Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carried away by the momentum, Hishi 
Miracle ended up declaring she would win 
the Tenno Sho (Spring)!
